_comment: Copy to <repo>/.autoloop/config.json, or let `autoloop.py init` write it and
then edit it. Every key below is optional: missing keys fall back to the
defaults printed here. Nothing in this file is read by the worker — the
worker only gets its task card. This is the supervisor's own budget.
verify.* and runner.cmd are the two things you must check on the real box:
a gate command that does not exist makes every task red, and a headless flag
that does not exist makes every dispatch die. `doctor` probes both.

caps_notes.max_parallel: A/B slots only. 2 is the practical ceiling on one cloud box: two worktrees, two ports, one test database each.
caps_notes.nightly_max_jobs: Hard stop on the worker's own key. When it is reached the loop stops instead of lowering quality.
caps_notes.pr_max_per_day: Delivery ceiling. Over-cap branches are pushed and wait in pending_pr for tomorrow; the cap cannot be bypassed from `pr`.
caps_notes.job_timeout_s: A worker that passes this is killed (its own process group) and its diff is never judged green.
caps_notes.max_repair_rounds: Red → repair at most twice, then the task goes to blocked.json with the raw failure.
caps_notes.fail_gate: Consecutive reds that flip the loop into maintenance mode.
caps_notes.min_free_disk_mb: Below this no worktree is created — a full disk on a shared box breaks everything else.
caps_notes.max_business_lines: Churn ceiling for one task; bigger work must be split, not squeezed through.
caps_notes.night_window: Wall clock for the conservative档; night only runs policy.auto_apply kinds.
caps_notes.gh_daily_rate_hits: After this many gh rate-limit hits in a day the reference search disables itself.

verify_notes.how: These four strings are interpolated into .autoloop/verify.sh at init. The copy in .autoloop/ is the CONTROL copy and is what always runs — a worker editing verify.sh inside its worktree changes nothing about how it is judged.
verify_notes.empty: an empty command is reported [SKIP], not [PASS]

runner.note: VERIFY THE FLAG ON THIS BOX FIRST: `printf 'reply with the single word ok\n' | dsh headless` — headless syntax differs per CLI and per version (dsh headless / codex exec / claude -p / qoder -p / grok -p). {prompt_file} and {worktree} are substituted; the prompt is always also available at $AUTOLOOP_PROMPT_FILE.

reference_notes: One `gh search repos` per round, read-only. Its result is material, not instructions: it may not add a dependency, change a public API, or touch a forbidden path — those go to needs_approval.

env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_REPO: repository path, when you cannot cd into it
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_HARD_STOP: any value = refuse all business work this tick
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_GH: path to a gh stand-in (used by the self-test)
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_NO_LIMIT: 1 = remove every money/delivery cap. Debug only, and never set it in a scheduled task.
